views_actually_inspected.detail: view_image original on the persisted SHA-bound PNG

accepted: The field is strictly flat and edge-to-edge, with no semantic geography.
Broad and mid-scale masses are irregular, non-directional, and show no visible tiling or copied stamp.
The final cleanup removes the earlier pepper grain and scalloped cell boundaries sufficiently for bounded luminance extraction.
There are no isolated bright particles, hard lines, contour loops, perspective peaks, labels, or watermark artifacts.
limitations: The raw RGB has a warm-brown palette and must not transfer chroma or absolute luminance.
The broad cloudy phase is source material, not authored geography and not a final map layer.
The source is deliberately soft; useful map-scale relief must come from canonical geometry and separately qualified body relief.
No numerical Golden or final-candidate gate is inferred from this visual source review.

forbidden: semantic shape, coastline, road, river, settlement, or label authority
